name: Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
summary: Model continuous-time hidden-state dynamics with a neural vector field integrated by a numerical ODE solver.
core_idea: Use a learned right-hand side du/dt=f_theta(u,t) and differentiate through numerical integration for training.
innovation: Connects continuous-time state-space representation, learnable dynamics and differentiable solvers.
limitations: Solver numerical tolerance and stability affect gradients.
Unobserved states may not be identifiable from sparse measurements.

start_here.why: Landmark introduction to continuous-depth neural dynamics.
start_here.focus: Neural vector field, black-box solver, continuous adjoint training.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
